name: Letha
description: The village Astor retreated to and used as tinder against Skouras.

description_citations.text: "Astor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor retreats to Letha, blows up the village to ground Skouras, and kills him by channeling the power of Keld into the dragon's mind.
timeline.quote: This had the rather spectacular effect of exploding the dragon's head.
